column1: **Agentic Coding in production:** coding agents on Claude take tickets to a pull request, with a quality gate before every push — over 750 tasks so far.

**Process automation with LLM agents:** bookkeeping of a German GmbH, bank reconciliation, lead alerts and operations — with human approval before anything irreversible and over 40 purpose-built verification tools.
**~{career_years} years of full-stack development** (since 1997), freelance throughout — the foundation for agents that fit real systems.
**Java/Spring Boot microservices** with Vue.js and React front-ends — end-to-end with Docker, Kubernetes and GitLab CI.
**Second track in data science and machine learning** — Udacity ML Engineer & Data Analyst, Kaggle, writer at Towards Data Science.
**Broad industry exposure:** banking/finance, insurance, automotive, telecommunications, travel, industry, retail, marketing and startups.
